title: Rating buckets are CAPS, not targets
context: Anil's Sep-9 feedback via WhatsApp: 'For the ratings I would like to see the option to pick a limit of each bucket ie 80% AAA and 10% AA and then have the AI calculate the best spread to get maximum income.'
decision: planner_settings.buckets = { AAA:%, AA:%, A:%, BBB:% } are ceilings. There is no sum-to-100 requirement. The planner greedy-fills highest-yielding first within each cap. If caps sum below 100%, the leftover cash stays uninvested until caps rise.
alternatives_rejected: Equal-share targets (rejected — treasurer wants an upper bound, not a mandated split)
Min+max range per band (rejected — one dial is simpler; a treasurer sets the max risk they'll accept)
consequences: PlannerService._optimize does greedy yield-first within band caps + per-name cap + group cap
PlannerSettingsPanel labels controls as '% max' and the row header 'Rating caps' (not 'Rating targets')
Save is enabled whenever any cap > 0 — sum-check removed
The Blended candidate's tagline reads '≤50% AAA · ≤30% AA · ≤20% A' — never '50/30/20'
